The test image shows: a tomato stem with grayish-white fuzzy/powdery sporulation covering it, surrounded by wilted and brown dried leaves. The stem tissue is necrotic underneath the gray growth. This fuzzy gray coating on stem tissue is very characteristic of Botrytis (Gray Mold).

Now viewing one reference image for Gray_Mold:

The reference Gray_Mold image shows gray fuzzy Botrytis sporulation on a tomato fruit. The test image shows the same characteristic gray fuzzy sporulation but on a stem, with wilted brown leaves above. Both share the defining feature: grayish-white powdery/fuzzy fungal growth on necrotic tissue. The stem canker with gray sporulation causing leaf wilt above is classic Botrytis gray mold.
